title: Arigato, Japan!
subtitle: A winter journey through coastal light, Tokyo nights, and the cedar forests of Nikkō.

cover.alt: The illuminated red Hozomon gate at Senso-ji beneath a deep blue evening sky
cover.caption: Asakusa, between daylight and night.

chapters.title: Between the hills and the sea
paragraphs: A quieter beginning: red shrine gates, early pink blossoms, and the small paths between the hills and the water.
Out by the coast, the frame opens up. Clouds spread across the evening sky, a bird settles on a railing, and a single rock holds its place in the sea.

photos.alt: A small red shrine framed by a torii gate and rows of red flags
photos.caption: A little red among the winter trees.

photos.alt: Pink flowering trees along a hillside path beneath a cloudy evening sky
photos.caption: The first hints of pink.

photos.alt: A steep solitary rock rising from the sea beneath a pale sunset
photos.caption: One rock, a wide horizon.

chapters.title: Asakusa, in the details
paragraphs: The journey into the city begins with rails and platforms. Around Asakusa, the scale keeps changing: a quiet side street, a five-storey pagoda, the intricate gold inside a temple.
Incense hangs in the air. Lanterns light up the streets and courtyards, turning familiar shapes into something warmer as the sky grows darker.

photos.alt: Railway tracks and an empty platform receding beneath an overhead canopy
photos.caption: Following the lines into the city.

photos.alt: An ornate golden temple altar with hanging lanterns and carved details

photos.caption: A warm corner as the light fades.

photos.alt: Rows of illuminated yellow lanterns framing a central path at dusk
photos.caption: A courtyard full of light.

chapters.title: After the lights come on
paragraphs: Tokyo changes after dark. Reflections stretch across the river, a tower becomes a line of light, and whole buildings turn into patterns of colour.
Down at street level, there is another rhythm: bright shopfronts, narrow lanes, skewers on a small plate, and a warm meal at the counter.

photos.alt: A bridge lit in blue and orange reflecting in the dark Sumida River
photos.caption: Colour carried across the water.

photos.alt: Tokyo Skytree illuminated above the river with reflections below
photos.caption: A thin line of light above the river.

photos.caption: A building becomes a canvas.

chapters.title: Nikkō, beneath the cedars
paragraphs: Beyond the bright streets, the palette changes to cedar green, weathered stone, red timber, and gold. A red bridge crosses a cold river beneath the winter trees.
The eye moves from carved roof details to long rows of stone lanterns, then out along a quiet road. Red-capped figures line a path through the trees.

photos.alt: A red arched bridge spanning a rocky river in a wooded valley
photos.caption: Red against the winter river.

chapters.title: Tokyo, under snow
paragraphs: Another day gives the city a different outline. Snow settles on the station, bridges, and carefully shaped pines. Distant buildings fade into the weather.
Back among the temple roofs, red walls stand out against white tiles and branches. The familiar city has become quieter in the frame.

photos.alt: A snow-covered Tokyo boulevard with a few people and buildings disappearing into snowfall
photos.caption: The city fades into the snow.

photos.alt: The red brick facade of Tokyo Station seen through falling snow
photos.caption: Tokyo Station, in a softer light.

photos.alt: A red temple hall with a sweeping snow-covered roof above visitors carrying umbrellas
photos.caption: A white edge on every roof.

photos.alt: A small red and green pavilion with a snow-covered roof beneath winter trees
photos.caption: The small corners hold the snow, too.

chapters.title: One more crossing
paragraphs: The last frame returns to the movement of the city. At Shibuya, crossings fill, empty, and fill again beneath the signs and screens.
One photograph to hold all that motion, before the next journey begins.

photos.alt: Crowds crossing broad striped pedestrian crossings beneath the buildings and signs of Shibuya
photos.caption: The city, back in motion.
